arStrings.szText: "Why didn't you destroy the dagger completely?"
I wanted to, but a dream stayed my hand. I saw the dagger, blazing like a spear, piercing the heart of a great evil.
I tried to convince myself it meant nothing, but what if it did? What if fate had a purpose for her terrible gift?
As much as I feared the blade, as much as I hated it, I would not turn a blind eye to fate.
Player lead-in: “Why didn’t you destroy the dagger completely?”
